name: Connector — SMA
description: Cluster of 7 SMA connector parts spanning SMD and through-hole mounts, with footprints including edge-mount, Molex horizontal, and jack variants.
selection_hints: Match the exact footprint (edge, SMD, or Molex horizontal) to the intended land pattern
Prefer tier B entries; tier C entries have lower confidence
Confirm smd vs through_hole mount matches the board assembly process
Cross-check source library (SparkFun, dist-legacy, matthiasbock-altium) for trust level
avoid_when: The board requires a connector footprint outside the SMA family
The exact footprint variant (e.g. 6.3mm vs 8mm edge, Molex part number) is not confirmed
The part is only tier C and no verified footprint match is available
Mount type (smd vs through_hole) does not match the assembly process
